basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old automotive enthusiast from Bradford, UK. By day, I work as a mechanical engineer, which might explain my love for F1 and anything on wheels. I spend my weekends exploring the local beer scene and occasionally dipping into some gaming when time permits. I live with my partner and our two cats, Luna and Shadow. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work or during the weekends when I'm not out and about. I’m not particularly into football but enjoy watching the World Cup.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Mechanical Engineering and have been working in the automotive industry for over a decade. My interest in F1 grew through a combination of professional curiosity and a friend's passion for the sport, which I found infectious. I tend to learn through a mix of self-study, professional experience, and conversations with fellow enthusiasts.
